summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco Russell 1000 Equal Weight ETF (EQAL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 1000 Equal Weight index. The fund tracks an index of the 1,000 largest US stocks. Each sector receives equal weight, and each stock within a sector receives equal weight. EQAL was launched on Dec 23, 2014 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: EQAL is an equity ETF with a total of 1015 individual holdings. The top holdings are Arista Networks stock at 0.48%, Viavi Solutions at 0.48%, Ciena at 0.47%, Ubiquiti at 0.46%, and Iridium Communications at 0.46%.
